session_unverified: Identity temporarily unverified; current session data remains in memory
uploadPreparation: How your document will be protected
uploadSubtitle: Send your document for verification. Transfer and processing are separate steps.
uploadFormats: PDF, JPG, PNG or HEIC. Maximum 20 MiB. The server checks the actual content.
uploadConsent: I consent to AI processing of this document
uploadConsentHelp: Optional. File verification is separate from clinical interpretation or validation.
uploadDemoBlocked: Demo mode: you can inspect the form, but files are not sent. Uploads require authorized identity and storage.
uploadDiscardConfirm: The file and details held in memory will be lost. Documents or upload sessions already created on the server will not be deleted. Continue?
uploadInMemory: This tab holds an upload in memory.
uploadProgressUnknown: Transfer in progress; percentage is not yet available.
uploadMayRemoveOriginal: The server confirmed that this upload no longer requires your original copy. Keep any backups you need.
uploadKeepOriginal: Keep the original file: the server has not authorized discarding it.
uploadPrivacyTitle: Your document stays under your control
uploadMemoryHelp: The file and form are held only in memory while this tab remains open. After reloading or closing, you may need to select the file again. Check your exams before starting another upload to avoid duplicates.
uploadNoResumePromise: After a connection failure, explicitly retry once your session is revalidated. Transfer may restart from the beginning; there is no persistent queue or multipart resume.
uploadNoAutomaticDelete: WellQ does not delete files from your device. Cancel stops the local operation; data already received by the server may continue processing.
uploadInvalidFile: Use a safe filename and matching file extension and type: PDF, JPG, PNG or HEIC.
uploadInvalidSize: Select a non-empty file up to 20 MiB.
uploadInvalidMetadata: Check the document title, date and exam details.
uploadPutFailed: Storage did not confirm the transfer. The file is retained for an explicit retry.
uploadInvalidStorage: The received storage authorization is invalid. The document will not be sent using that configuration.
uploadExpiredUrl: Temporary authorization expired. Retry to request a new one.
uploadConnectionRequired: Continue with a connection, a revalidated patient session, and read/upload permissions.
uploadRetryLater: The server requested a delay before retrying. The operation is retained in memory.
uploadNotConfirmed: The server has not confirmed the upload. Keep the original and continue once connected.
uploadUnknownError: This step could not complete. The file is retained in this tab for inspection or retry.
error_413: The file exceeds the server's permitted size.
uploadPhase_selected: File selected. Nothing has been sent yet.
uploadPhase_hashing: Validating metadata and calculating the file's SHA-256 digest.
uploadPhase_uploading: Transferring the document to private storage.
uploadPhase_transferred: Storage confirmed transfer. Server verification is still pending.
uploadPhase_completing: Confirming the upload to request verification.
uploadPhase_processing: Processing is pending or in progress. See the checks reported by the server.
uploadPhase_available: Document verified and available. Clinical review is a separate step.
uploadPhase_rejected: The server rejected the document. Keep the original and inspect the file.
uploadPhase_failed: Processing failed. Keep the original; team support may be needed.
uploadPhase_deleted: The server deleted the document. This operation will not send it again.
uploadPhase_paused: Operation interrupted. File retained in memory; continue once your session and connection are available.
uploadPhase_cancelled: Local operation cancelled. The file remains in memory and you can explicitly continue.
uploadPhase_poll-limit: Automatic checks stopped at their limit. The server may still be processing.
uploadPhase_error: This step could not complete. No successful upload is claimed.
uploadExtraction_extraction_failed: Extraction failed; the file may be verified
uploadStepHash: Select the file and check its integrity.
uploadStepInitiate: Review the exam details and your consent.
uploadStepTransfer: Send the document privately using temporary authorization.
uploadStepVerify: Complete and check server status before permitting local deletion.
uploadPreparationPending: Uploads are not enabled yet. No document has been selected, sent, or synchronized.
offlineHelp: The interface and previously received data remain in memory during this session. Reading or sending new information requires a connection. No clinical operation queue is enabled.
demoOfflineHelp: You can continue exploring synthetic documents. The installed shell can reopen the demonstration offline; it does not replace the mobile app.
cachedInMemory: Previously received information from this session, not refreshed. No new operation has been confirmed and no persistent clinical copy has been stored.
draftInMemory: This identifier has not been queried yet. It stays in memory only; reloading or signing out discards it.
updateReady: A portal update is ready. Your in-memory work will not be reloaded automatically.
updateConfirm: Updating reloads the portal and discards unsent fields. Continue?
session_error: The provider operation failed; access remains closed
error_400: The server could not accept this request.
error_500: The server encountered an issue. The operation has not been confirmed.
error_timeout: The request timed out. Its outcome has not been confirmed.
demoNotice: Demonstration environment · All documents are synthetic. No real clinical data.
sessionHelp: This backend verifies tokens from an external provider. Identity integration is not configured in this portal yet.
noGrant: Your session does not have the clinical:read permission.
forbidden: This view is unavailable for your role.
overviewSubtitle: Organized documents, clear statuses, and human review at every step.
clinicalSubtitle: Explore an authorized patient's exams and prepare their clinical review.
patientIdHelp: Enter the identifier provided by your platform. The server verifies the clinical relationship.
patientRequired: Enter an identifier of 1 to 200 characters without spaces.
noPatient: Select a patient to view their exams.
examSubtitle: Explore documents and their processing status.
reviewCount: Ready for review on this page
pageOnly: Counts refer to the loaded page, not the complete history.
uploadPending: The upload form is available to patients. Sending documents requires authorized identity and storage. The offline queue belongs to the Flutter client.
clinicalPendingBody: Confirmation, validation, longitudinal tracking, and PDF export will use existing routes. This portal does not calculate scores or diagnoses.
patientPendingBody: Proposal confirmation will become available when its flow is integrated. Upload and clinical review are separate steps. Patients do not receive scores or clinical interpretation.
emptyBody: No exams were found for this patient with the selected filters.
errorTitle: We could not complete the request
offlineBody: Check your connection. This web portal does not store clinical documents for offline use.
error_0: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and the API URL.
error_401: Your session is invalid or expired. Sign in again through your identity provider.
error_403: The server denied access. Check permissions and the patient relationship.
error_409: The state changed or a conflict occurred. Refresh before trying again.
error_422: The server rejected the submitted parameters.
error_429: The request limit was reached. Wait before trying again.
error_503: A required service is unavailable. Try again later.
error_502: The response does not match the expected contract.
error_unknown: The request failed. Data has not been replaced with a demonstration.
detailNotice: File status and clinical review are different processes. A document ready for review does not imply confirmed or validated results.
catalogSubtitle: Explore the catalog published by the backend. Availability does not establish clinical validation.
serverAuthority: Permissions and the clinical relationship are verified by the server.
configurationError: The portal could not start. Check your local configuration.
